critical_code_review_comments: strategies.py mark(): per-leg Tradier chain_for calls run serially inside list_strategies (asyncio.gather is across strategies, not within legs). For users with many multi-expiry strategies this adds latency. Consider deduping chains per (ticker,expiration) across all user strategies in a single batch.

strategies.py check_hits(): uses mongo $set per hit AND inserts alert_event; two awaits per hit are not atomic. If server dies between insert and $set, duplicate events could occur next tick. Low priority — in practice GET /strategies is idempotent and 'fired' flag covers 99% of cases.

chain.py analyze_position(): _mixed_stats breakeven detection uses a 401-point grid 0.3S..2.5S. For deep OTM / wide calendars, breakeven root-finding by linear interpolation on a coarse grid can produce slight mislocation (~$0.5). Acceptable but noted.

chain.py _value_at(): max(left, 0.5) is only applied in bs_greeks call for `greeks` loop (line 136), but _value_at() uses left/365 directly which can be <=0 before falling into intrinsic branch. The branch guard (left <= 0) handles this but the subsequent bs_greeks still receives left/365 where left could be 0+; wrap with max(left,0.5)/365 for safety.

frontend portfolio.tsx strategies fetch has no visible loading/error state while /api/strategies is slow (observed one playwright run where strategies-section was briefly not rendered after tab switch). Consider showing a skeleton while loading.
